title: THE WATER BELONGS TO
steps: Recover pump component from Scrap Alley
Control Booth: give key commons OR give key syndicate
commons: You place the access key in the public receiver. Downstairs, taps open without asking names. Iona laughs once, like a valve coming loose. Tomorrow somebody will try to own this. Tonight the water belongs to whoever is thirsty.
lease: You place the access key in the syndicate receiver. Pressure returns. So do the meters. The company pays you promptly; it has always been good at paying the people who make other people pay. Your name appears on a small brass plaque.
